meta.title: Unlock bids "For Myself" with a second-user OTP
gaps: Have the second pre-set user receive the OTP by email or SMS and provide it
Enter and submit the OTP for the second-user authorization
Verify that bids remain hidden for another user with access while visible to the initiator
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Have the second pre-set user receive the OTP by email or SMS and provide it; Enter and submit the OTP for the second-user authorization; Verify that bids remain hidden for another user with access while visible to the initiator

steps.note: Open an existing event whose submission window has closed and whose bids can be unlocked.
Open the event's Responses tab, which is the subject of the test.
Open the event Settings menu where Unlock Bids is expected to be available.
Confirm that the Unlock Bids dialog or flow is visible.
Choose the initiating-user visibility option required by the case.

args.need: select the second pre-set user as the OTP recipient, send the OTP, obtain it from that user, enter and submit it, then verify the unlocked bids are visible only to the initiator and hidden for another user with access

steps.note: The remaining flow requires another user's OTP and a second-user session, which the catalog cannot perform.
Assert the stated successful unlock confirmation after the tester completes the missing authorization flow.
